instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb.

hint.text: If the action has already taken place, use the past tense. If the action will happen in the future, use the future tense.

wrong.text: The word 'tomorrow' shows that the action will take place in the future, so you have to use the future tense.
'Next winter' shows that the action will take place in the future, so you have to use the future tense.

atoms.b: Last night, I ((++talked will_talk)) to my uncle on the phone.

wrong.text: 'Last night' shows that the action has already happened, so you have to use the past tense.
The word 'soon' shows that the action will take place in the future, so you have to use the future tense.

atoms.b: Yesterday, I ((++made will_make)) pasta for lunch.

wrong.text: 'Yesterday' shows that the action has already happened, so you have to use the past tense.

atoms.b: A few weeks ago, my sister ((++surprised will_surprise)) me with a puppy.

wrong.text: 'A few weeks ago' shows that the action has already happened, so you have to use the past tense.
